qa_pair.question: In the archived place-and-route runs, find the stage at which setup timing was finally met (no violating paths). How many setup-violating paths did the run immediately before it report? Answer with an integer, digits only.

Among the archived circuit simulations, take the successful small-signal frequency analysis of the two-stage amplifier. At what frequency does its output gain cross 0 dB? Answer in MHz rounded to the nearest integer, digits only.
One archived analog simulation stopped before simulating because a device referenced something that was never defined. What is the name of that missing model or subcircuit? Answer with the name only.
Of the configured Cadence installations, which one has a circuit simulator too old to use the Spectre X engine? Answer with the profile name only.
In the amplifier library, one cell has a simulation setup view (ADE Explorer/Assembler) but no physical layout. Which cell is it? Answer with the cell name only.
In the schematic of the two-stage OTA, what is the total drawn width, in micrometres, of all p-channel transistors? Answer with a number only, no unit.
In the archived logic synthesis run, which warning message ID occurs most often? Answer with the ID exactly as printed (for example ABC-123).
One archived UVM regression did not pass. What is the name of the UVM test it ran? Answer with the test name only.
In the archived transient simulation, what is the highest voltage reached by the output node? Answer in volts rounded to two decimals, digits only.
How many cells of the Cadence analog primitives library provide a Verilog-A view? Answer with an integer, digits only.
